paper_title: Exploration of the polarization angle variability of the Crab Nebula with POLARBEAR and its application to the search for axion-like particles
notes: Bound from polarization angle oscillation of Crab Nebula (Tau A) at 150 GHz. Stochastic bound: g_agamma <= 2.16e-12 GeV^-1 * (m_a/1e-21 eV) over mass range 9.9e-23 to 7.7e-19 eV (with sinc rolloff at high mass, ignored here for linear approximation). Endpoints computed from linear relation: at 9.9e-23 eV -> 2.14e-14, at 7.7e-19 eV -> 1.66e-10 (before sinc suppression).
